note: Resources for the AI Security pathway and the security foundations taught in Weeks 1-2. Each is attached as optional to a calendar day, so it never adds required work.

resources.title: Client-server overview
resources.why: How a browser or app asks a server for something and gets an answer: the picture behind every sign-in, API and agent.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: Overview of HTTP
resources.why: Requests, responses, methods, status codes and headers in plain terms. Read up to and including the section on HTTP messages.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
resources.why: The standard reference for how risk is assessed: threat, vulnerability, likelihood and impact. Read the abstract and skim the risk model figure.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization
resources.why: The most common API flaw: a signed-in user changes an id in a request and gets someone else's data. A clear example of authorization failing after authentication succeeded.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: Password Storage Cheat Sheet
resources.why: Why passwords are hashed rather than encrypted, in practice. Read the introduction and the section on hashing versus encryption.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: NIST Privacy Framework
resources.why: How privacy risk differs from security risk, and how organisations manage both. Read the overview page.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: LLM02:2025 Sensitive Information Disclosure
resources.why: How AI systems leak data they should not show: from training data, from connected sources and from other users' context.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: LLM06:2025 Excessive Agency
resources.why: When an AI system has more functions, permissions or autonomy than its task needs, and what limits that.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: LLM08:2025 Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
resources.why: The risks in retrieval (RAG): documents reaching people who should not see them, and poisoned content entering the knowledge base.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: Model Context Protocol: Security Best Practices
resources.why: How the protocol many agents use to reach tools handles consent, tokens and confused-deputy problems. Skim the headings; read the user consent parts closely.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.

resources.title: MITRE ATLAS
resources.why: A knowledge base of real attack techniques against AI systems, modelled on ATT&CK. Browse the matrix and open two techniques.
resources.verifiedNote: Checked on Nov 4, 2026: the page loads and its title matches.
